name: CFPS Inhibitor Dose Response (Part 3)
description: Part 3 of the TEM-1 inhibitor screen: doses each of up to 8 already-expressed TEM1 wells (built by cfps_mastermix / Part 1, confirmed by cfps_sfgfp_confirmation / Part 2) with its own compound volume from a pre-arrayed compound_library plate plus nitrocefin substrate, then reads the plate kinetically — the initial slope of A490 vs time is the enzyme's velocity, and inhibition drops that slope. One run, no seal/shake: the kinetic time course is captured live by the reader.
author: pipeline

nodes.label: Kinetic Read (nitrocefin inhibition)
nodes.description: Assumes the operator has selected a kinetic (A490, nitrocefin) protocol in Gen5 before this run. Initial slope of A490 vs time = enzyme velocity per well.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: run started
nodes.description: Registers this execution in data/logs/ before any hardware moves, so a run that fails early is still visible to the tracker instead of leaving nothing behind. Its outgoing edge is deliberately 'default', not 'on_success': a checkpoint is bookkeeping, and a failure to record progress must never abort a run that is physically fine. The validator flags this as unconditional — that is the intent.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: pipetting done
nodes.description: Refreshes the run folder once all pipetting is complete, before labware handling — so a failure during plate/reader moves still has every dispensed leg on record. Its outgoing edge is deliberately 'default', not 'on_success': a checkpoint is bookkeeping, and a failure to record progress must never abort a run that is physically fine. The validator flags this as unconditional — that is the intent.
